tools.name: lookup_rules
tools.description: Returns what a US state's own sources (its boards, register and laws) and the federal agencies (FDA, HHS, DEA) have published about a peptide or compounded drug, quoted word for word, each with its source link and the date Provkeep last read it. Says plainly when nothing is on record and how much of

tools.name: precheck_order
tools.description: For an order before a prescriber or pharmacist reviews it: for each product, returns what the destination state's own sources and the federal agencies published, quoted with source and date, and marks any sentence that is limited to a purpose or a type of consult. Records nothing and returns no pass

tools.name: nonresident_licensing
tools.description: Returns what a state's pharmacy board publishes about licensing a pharmacy located outside that state that ships into it, quoted word for word with source and date, grouped by topic. Says which states Provkeep reads for this when the state asked about is not one of them. Counts as one lookup.

tools.name: list_sources
tools.description: Lists the official sources Provkeep reads every night in one state, or federally when no state is given, whether each answered on its latest reading and when. Shows how much a silence in that state tells you. Does not count as a lookup.

tools.name: list_products
tools.description: Lists every peptide and compounded drug Provkeep reads rules for, with the other names each one is matched by. Does not count as a lookup.

tools.name: account_usage
tools.description: Returns the signed-in Provkeep account's plan, the lookups used this calendar month and its monthly allowance, and when the count resets. Does not count as a lookup.

tools.name: record_order
tools.description: Sends one order to the signed-in Record account, where it is checked against its state and kept with the rule that applied that day, exactly as POST /v2/checks does (https://provkeep.com/developers). Returns what each source says for each line and never holds or refuses the order. Send codes only: t

tools.name: record_shipment
tools.description: Records on a Record account that an order already sent with record_order has shipped, naming the lot each line shipped from, so the order is tied to that lot and its confirmed certificate. The same as POST /v2/orders/{reference}/events with kind shipped (https://provkeep.com/developers). Appended, n

tools.name: list_audits
tools.description: Lists the compliance and underwriting audits made for the signed-in Record account, each with its period, when it was made, and its SHA-256 fingerprint, with the link to download them on provkeep.com.

tools.name: what_needs_attention
tools.description: Returns the list on the signed-in account's Home screen: states that published wording about the products it sells, watched pages that changed, bills that moved, its own orders answered Restricted, and what its audits found missing from its records, each with its date and a link. Looks back 7 days u

tools.name: list_orders
tools.description: Lists the signed-in account's orders, newest first, as its Orders screen shows them: reference, date, ship-to state, products, the reading recorded for each, and on the Record plan the lots tied and whether consent was recorded. A test key lists test orders. Does not count as a lookup.

tools.name: get_order
tools.description: Returns one of the signed-in account's orders by its reference: each line's product, ship-to state and recorded reading, the rules quoted with their sources, and on the Record plan the lot each line shipped from, that lot's confirmed certificate, the consent recorded and what happened after the sale

tools.name: list_changes
tools.description: Lists the changes Provkeep found on the official pages it reads, newest first, for the products the signed-in account watches: which page, which state, when, what kind of change and which products it names, with the page's link. Optional state and number of days (default 30). Does not count as a loo

tools.name: list_watched_products
tools.description: Lists the products the signed-in account watches, which decide its alerts and its Home list. An account that has not chosen watches every product. Does not count as a lookup.

tools.name: hhs_conditions
tools.description: Returns the conditions in HHS's 503A peptide enforcement discretion policy, quoted word for word, with the policy's link and the peptides it lists in Appendix A. Does not count as a lookup.

tools.name: list_lots
tools.description: Lists the signed-in Record account's lots: product, lot number, status, whether a person has confirmed its certificate and from which manufacturer, its expiry and beyond-use dates, how many orders it shipped on, and its public verify link. Does not count as a lookup.

tools.name: create_lot
tools.description: Adds a lot to the signed-in Record account, the same as POST /v1/lots (https://provkeep.com/developers). Its certificate is uploaded and confirmed by a person on provkeep.com, never through this tool. Set activate to true when the lot starts shipping now.

tools.name: record_lot_dates
tools.description: Records a lot's expiry date, beyond-use date or both, the same as POST /v1/lots/{id}/dates. Appended: an earlier date stays on record. Takes the lot_id from list_lots or create_lot, and dates as YYYY-MM-DD.

tools.name: set_watched_products
tools.description: Replaces the list of products the signed-in Record account watches, which decides its alerts and its Home list. Send every product to keep, by name. An empty list means every product, including ones Provkeep adds later.
